title: Recipe 52 — Active context curation (dedupe and re-order before you compact)

beats.label: Open the recipe
beats.cue: “Autocompact is reactive — it fires when the window is already full and pays a model call. Curation runs before that, and it is a pure function.”

beats.label: Blank the scratch spec
beats.cue: live/ is scratch — the committed recipe is never touched by a take.

beats.label: Load the API key
beats.cue: [needs-key] Sources demos/.env for the boot beat. Nothing in the curation path itself needs it.

groups.title: Beat 1 · the spec — RAG is the canonical duplicate-chunk case

beats.label: Name it, pick the shape
beats.cue: “target: pipeline — the recipe picks RAG because the same chunks surface turn after turn. That pile-up is what the curator eats.”

beats.label: Add the agent block
beats.cue: “One instruction. Curation is not a prompt technique — nothing here mentions it.”

beats.label: Over-retrieve on purpose
beats.cue: “defaultK: 10 is deliberate over-retrieval. Embeddings are already paid for in the vector store, so fetching ten and curating to five is the cheap direction.”

beats.label: Add the chunker and the corpus
beats.cue: “Two documents inline. Small on purpose — the point of the drive is the knobs below, not the corpus.”

beats.label: Turn the curator on
beats.cue: “Three lines: curate, the cosine threshold duplicates are collapsed at, and the top-K cap. That is the entire opt-in surface.”

beats.label: Lint the spec
beats.cue: “Clean. Which is exactly why the next beat matters — lint parses, it does not boot.”

beats.label: Check the bundle — and watch it go RED
beats.cue: “Deliberate, exit 1: the recipe's fence writes the embedder as `voyage-3-large` with no provider prefix. Lint can't see that; boot can, and --check is the boot.”

verify.note: measured exit 1: RED — assertion ok (4 anchors); install ok; boot failed — `EmbedderError: unknown embedder prefix in "voyage-3-large" — expected openai/, voyage/, cohere/, gemini/, local/<m>@<url>, or mock/`. The bundle is still emitted before the boot, so live/dist exists either way.

beats.label: Take the error's advice
beats.cue: “The error prints the accepted prefixes. mock/det is the deterministic offline one — so the whole curation path runs with no embedding credentials at all.”

beats.label: Check it again
beats.cue: “Same spec, one token different: GREEN, and the only thing left missing is the provider credential the spec itself declares.”

verify.note: measured exit 0: GREEN — assertion ok (4 anchors); install ok; boot gated (boot reached its provider credentials gate)

beats.label: Show the lowered IR
beats.cue: “The recipe was written when curate lived only in the emitter. On 0.4.x it is real IR surface — which is what lets the optimizer reach it.”

verify.note: measured: IR for target pipeline, redirected to scratch — the next beat opens it

beats.label: Open the IR
beats.cue: “compaction.curate, dedupeThreshold, relevanceTopK — all three lowered, nothing invented.”

beats.label: Name the three knobs out loud
beats.cue: “These are the same three keys spec-patch lists in OPTIMIZABLE_PATHS, which is what makes `crewhaus optimize` able to tune curation.”

verify.note: measured: three matches inside the compaction record of the IR

beats.label: Try crewhaus run first
beats.cue: “Deliberate rejection, exit 1: only cli and browser run straight from the spec. Pipeline is compile-first.”

verify.note: measured: `crewhaus run supports target: cli or browser (got "pipeline")`

beats.label: Boot the bundle
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Indexing and embedding run at process start with mock/det — keyless. The chat loop is what wants the provider.”

verify.note: indexes offline, then needs Anthropic credentials for the loop

beats.label: Ask the same thing twice
beats.cue: [needs-key] “Ask a variant of the question you just asked. Without curation the second retrieval piles the same chunks on again; with it, the duplicates collapse.”
beats.text: What is the refund window, and how long does a refund take to process?

verify.note: multi-turn is what makes duplicate chunks accumulate

beats.label: Exit the loop
beats.cue: [needs-key] “exit” returns to the shell.

groups.title: One more thing · the whole opt-in surface, as a diff

beats.label: Type the recipe's curate() call
beats.cue: “The spec flag is sugar over this: items in, deduped and re-ordered items out, plus the bytes it saved. A pure function — no model call, no I/O.”

beats.label: Read it
beats.cue: “Note the chunks arrive with embeddings already attached — tool-retrieve computed them for the vector search, so the dedupe pass costs nothing extra.”

beats.label: Turn the curator off
beats.cue: “Now flip one word and re-lower, so we can see exactly what the flag buys.”

beats.label: Lower it again
beats.cue: “Same spec, same corpus, curator off.”

beats.label: Diff the two IRs
beats.cue: “Exit 1 because they differ — and they differ in exactly one line. Curation is a flag, not an architecture.”

verify.note: diff exits 1 when the files differ, which is the assertion here. Measured: one hunk, `"curate": true` → `"curate": false`

beats.label: Open the diff
beats.cue: “One line of spec, one line of IR, and 60 to 80 percent fewer context tokens on a multi-turn RAG loop. That is the trade the recipe is arguing for.”
